name: Net Shares (SA)
help: List network shares on local or remote computer.
long_help: Enumerates network shares on the specified computer. Standard mode shows share name and remark. Admin mode (requires admin privileges) shows additional details including local path and current connection count.

arguments.name: computername
arguments.desc: Target computer to query (defaults to local system if not specified)

arguments.name: as-admin
arguments.desc: Show admin-level details including local paths (0 = basic info, 1 = admin info; default: 0)
